issues.title: Ingest Poinsett County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $14,481,267 across 26 funds. The largest: County General Fund ($3,225,698), Road Fund ($3,073,964), County Jail Fund ($2,567,257). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.
